issues.description: Field type mismatch for Lecture.numberOfInscribedStudents: the problem statement/UML specifies it as int, but the reference solution declares it as long. This also forces different getter/setter and constructor parameter types than students expect from the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Use int consistently for numberOfInscribedStudents in the solution (field, constructor parameter, getter/setter) to match the UML/spec, or update the UML/spec (and any dependent signatures/return types) to explicitly use long.

issues.description: Return type/implementation inconsistency in Lecture.getTotalNumberOfStudents(): the UML/spec declares the method returns int, but the solution implementation adds a long (numberOfInscribedStudents) to an int (numberOfGuestStudents), yielding a long result that cannot be returned as int without an explicit cast. This makes the provided solution code uncompilable as written and conflicts with the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the types consistent: either change numberOfInscribedStudents back to int (keeping getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int), or if long is intended, change the UML/spec and update getTotalNumberOfStudents() to return long and adjust dependent methods accordingly.
